response.overview: A clone is born into a factory world. Conditioned. Identical. Compliant. One learns to feel instead of think. He breaks free. He wins. He dies at the moment of victory.  Exodus & Cut Thumb is a multimedia album campaign combining a short film, vlog series, clothing line, physical CD and exhibition installation into one unified world. Rooted in the philosophy of Jean-Michel Basquiat — a man who broke into a world not built for him and was consumed by it — the project asks whether freedom from a system is ever truly free, or whether the breaking costs everything.
response.tagline: The system made you. The system will bury you.
response.title: Exodus & Cut Thumb
